<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-1809-20-06" status="unreviewed">mnyam bzhag du chos nyid stong pa nyid la dang po mthong pa tshad ma rgyun du 'jug pa bcad
               <lb n="48b8"/>shes chos can ma lus pa'i chos nyid la ltos nas snang la ma nges pa'o || 'o na sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'byor mngon suM gang du 'du na snang la ma nges pa med la | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na re bad shes kyang med de yul dang yul can dbyer med du zhi bas rtogs zin gyi don la 'jug pa mi srid pa'i phyir zhes zer la | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha 1</rs> na re dngos po rnams kyi rdzas la tshad ma rigs la bcad shes yino zhe <expan>zer ro</expan> ¦</seg></TEI>
